submit-a-signed-bundle-without-sending-a.text: Issue 640, third of five tickets under issue 490. This page records the story, the requirements and the refusals. The write commands that produce bundles (issue 641) and the open-datum commands (issue 642) are not part of it.

story.text: As Bob, I hand back the witnesses for a bundle and run singular submit --witnesses FILE ... BUNDLE with the node settings. The command sends the transactions in the bundle's order and prints a receipt written from what the chain shows. If I run it again after a crash, it sends only the transactions that are still missing. If a body has expired it says "rebuild" and sends nothing. The command needs no wallet key and keeps no state of its own.

requirements.text: witness-matches-its-body: each witness is matched to a transaction by verifying its signature over that body's identity, never by its file name.

refusals.text: Exit with a named refusal and nothing sent: bundle unreadable or inconsistent (as in the signing step); witness unreadable; witness for a different body; witness for a key no transaction needs; needed witness missing; expired body (rebuild); input neither in an earlier body nor on the chain.

limits-recorded.text: The effect lines are the writer's claims, shown and not confirmed; structured effects belong to a later bundle version.
